label: Peplink AP One Flex
description: Wall-plate style 802.11ac access point with three gigabit Ethernet ports.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink AP One datasheet: **3x GE Ethernet LAN ports** for the Flex. Those three ports are the reason to pick it over a plain AP - one uplink and two switched ports for a desk phone and a PC - but the radio is 802.11ac class, so the copper outruns the wireless.
